_comment: The single source for SheOut's business details and its list of processors. Every legal page, footer and contact screen reads from here. TODO_FROM_OWNER is shown as a visible placeholder and makes a strict production build (LEGAL_STRICT_BUILD=true) fail. Never replace a placeholder with a guess. A processor appears in the Privacy Policy only while live is true.
brandLine: SheOut, a brand of Snivika Technology Private Limited

grievanceOfficers._comment: One entry per grievance regime, each a list of appointments. To change an officer, add an appointment with its effectiveFrom date (YYYY-MM-DD) - the pages show the one in effect on the day they are read, and earlier ones stay on record. Never delete a past appointment. Which regimes apply is for the lawyer to confirm (docs/legal-open-items.md).
